content.rendered:
Join us at our next Dinner Night Out, Wednesday December 17th, at the Sherwood Red Robin. Show the flyer below, or simply mention the fundraiser to your server to have your sales counted. 20% of food sales will be donated back to Hawks View PAC.

You may also order online by following the instructions listed on the flyer.

Red Robin DNO/English

Red Robin DNO/Spanish
